NOTEPAD

TASK SHEET

INTERN INSTRUCTION

Welcome to Corporate International Systems. This sheet lives at your desk. Come back and read it any time.

Your buttons

Wait lets the clock run when you are early, or when the person you need is somewhere else for a while. Pick how long to wait. Waiting is not free, and people notice if you do it all day.

Task Sheet is your work, written down. The Boss's Task is Dale's job for you. Coworker Tasks are the favors you agreed to. You can open it any time, even in the middle of a conversation.

Notepad is yours alone. Nobody reads it and nothing in it is graded. Codes, counts, and names are worth writing down here the moment you hear them.

Settings holds the typing speed and the music volume. It also holds Achievements: the full list of what there is to earn in this building, with a hint for each one you have not found yet.

The three numbers

Reputation: people here keep score of how you do.

Pay: work pays. What you keep of it is another question.

Patience: yours runs out long before the building's does. Snacks help.

MAINTENANCE PANEL: WIRING

Drag each plug to an empty terminal and use the spare to sort them. Click any wire to bring it to the front. Seat every wire in its own color to finish.

COPIER: PAPER PATH

Drag the crumpled sheet along the track to the exit slot, easing it free where it sticks.

THE SMOKERS' PUZZLE

A 64 piece jigsaw. Drag a piece onto another to swap them, or click one piece, then the piece to trade with it.
